value.rationale: The exact relative projection norm and the necessary-and-sufficient contractive-complementability transition w=m hold for the entire natural family of Walsh star spectral spaces across arbitrary finite dimension and positive metric anisotropy. This is a meaningful classification of a stable Banach-space invariant with an explicit extremizing construction and nontrivial change of geometric behavior, not a special numeric example or a routine reformulation of the uniform-norm Fourier theorem.
